cards.text: @desk ⏎ Desk · Lead 2 ⏎ 1h ⏎ Make Decision Desk the default Normal landing page? ⏎ Decides: Sets whether opening the app lands on Decision Desk or Project Overview ⏎ LEAN ⏎ Yes, default landing + sidebar entry ⏎ Sidebar entry only ⏎ None of these

@ade ⏎ ADE · Lead 1 ⏎ 1h ⏎ Merge URL history cleanup into master now? ⏎ Decides: Ships U1+U2 Back/Forward fixes ahead of the next beta cut ⏎ LEAN ⏎ Merge after green suite ⏎ Hold for D4 bundle ⏎ None of these
@bug ⏎ Bugs · Lead 1 ⏎ 1h ⏎ Which default timeout (ms) should idle worker health checks use? ⏎ Decides: Controls when quiet workers flip to stalled in the sidebar ⏎ Dismiss

@desk ⏎ Overlord ⏎ inferred ⏎ 3m ⏎ Partial-fill entry handling: A, B, or C? Also add a veto window on the check-5 same-ticker block? ⏎ Decides: A spec change for partial-fill entries, plus whether the owner can veto the check-5 block ⏎ Hide source ▴ ⏎ A: fill-or-kill at entry — cancel the order unless it fills completely ⏎ B: keep the partial fill and resize the stop to the filled size ⏎ C: top up
cards.source:
Partial fills are the last open question on the entry path.
A) fill-or-kill at entry: cancel the order unless it fills completely
B) keep the partial fill and resize the stop to the filled size
C) top up the remainder at the next bar's open
Separately: should I add a 30s veto window on the check-5 same-ticker block?

@importer ⏎ Importer · Lead 1 ⏎ 18m ⏎ Allow non-power-of-two textures in dev builds? ⏎ Decides: Relaxes asset import validation outside release builds ⏎ LEAN ⏎ Warn in dev, error in release ⏎ Error everywhere ⏎ None of these
@ci ⏎ CI · Lead 1 ⏎ 11m ⏎ Which artifact retention window (days) do we want for nightly builds? ⏎ Decides: Sets storage cleanup policy on the build bucket ⏎ Dismiss

@ci ⏎ CI · Lead 1 ⏎ inferred ⏎ 1m ⏎ U11 survivorship: (a) survivor-only with coverage %, or (b) stop at A1? ⏎ Decides: Sets U11 scope and whether delisted rows are deferred ⏎ Hide source ▴ ⏎ a: survivor-only — keep only listed tickers and report coverage % ⏎ b: stop at A1 — ship the A1 universe and defer delisted data ⏎ None of these
cards.source:
U11 needs a call on survivorship before we freeze the dataset.
(a) survivor-only: keep only listed tickers and report coverage %
(b) stop at A1: ship the A1 universe and defer delisted data
